name: Tooyama Saku
source:
A member of "Genius 4".
A soft spoken girl who wears headphones. She appears to have a thing for retro technology and is almost always seen with a lollipop in her mouth.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Opera_Milky_Holmes#Genius_4]Wikipedia[/url].]
